cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned my glass upside down like yours. What time did you clear the extra place last night?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's chipped; it's waiting to be thrown away. We cleared the table at ten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, clearing unsafe things. Was that before the last bus went?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: After it. I drove to the station instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which station car park did you use? I'm deciding how much petrol to leave in the car.
